text: Every year, money slips through the cracks.
Refunds. Price protection. Rewards. Rebates.
Only two out of a hundred ever get it back.
ClaimIt turns that paperwork into an AI workflow.
A receipt reaches ClaimIt — forwarded from your inbox, or uploaded by hand.
Gemini reads it and pulls out the merchant, item, date, and price.
It's stored in MongoDB, and an agent watches the price and the claim window.
When a drop clears the policy, the agent drafts the claim for you.
You approve it — and every decision, tool call, and draft is traced.
It starts with a receipt.
Upload a photo or a PDF — or let ClaimIt read it from your inbox.
ClaimIt pulls out the details for you.
The merchant, the item, the date, and the price.
Each value lifted from the receipt — yours to check and correct.
Then it watches the claim window in the background.
Days pass, and it keeps checking the price for you.
When Costco drops the price, ClaimIt catches it.
It checks the policy, so you do not have to.
Then Gemini drafts the email with the right context.
Ask for a warmer tone, and it rewrites it.
Seconds later, the new version is ready to review.
Or make a quick edit yourself.
Your wording, saved as a fresh draft.
Review it once, then approve.
ClaimIt sends the claim. You stay focused.
A banner confirms it — sent from your own Gmail.
Every claim, tracked from draft to outcome.
We mapped refund policies across twenty-six retailers.
Costco, Macy's, Dell and others run on auto-send. Best Buy and Target run on a chat script today.
Under the hood, each claim is an agent workflow.
Gemini ADK handles reasoning, tools, and draft generation.
MongoDB Atlas holds every claim state, queried through MCP.
Phoenix traces each decision, tool call, and draft.
So the workflow is visible, reviewable, and ready to extend.
ClaimIt. AI does the paperwork. You approve.
